steps.body: Adding a multiple of ten changes only the tens digit. The ones digit stays exactly the same.

widget.prompt: Start at 43. Add one ten. Where do you land?
widget.missFeedback: Start at 43 and count on 10: you land on 53.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 53 — the tens digit went up by one; the ones stayed at 3.

predict.prompt: You add one ten to 43. Which digit changes?
